name: verdict
description: Build rule-based decision, eligibility, or policy-evaluation logic using the verdict rule-evaluation engine (Rule/FunctionRule/AndRule/OrRule/RulesEngine) instead of a hand-rolled if/elif chain. Covers eligibility checks, discount/pricing rules, access conditions, content-moderation routing, qualification requirements, and testing rule-based logic (short-circuit proofs, vacuous-truth cases, oracle/differential testing).
